SEARCH
Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update

Class UpdateService

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.UpdateService
public class UpdateService extends Object
Orchestrates the whole update pipeline: detection, download, verification, installation, notifications, scheduled installations, changelog rendering and version downgrade.

  • Constructor Details

    • UpdateService

      public UpdateService()
      Creates a service with its own event bus and the layered configuration.

      The metadata endpoint is taken from update.url; see createDefault() for the recommended factory that reads the configuration once and shares it with the repository.

    • UpdateService

      public UpdateService(UpdateRepository repository)
      Creates a service with its own event bus and the layered configuration.
      Parameters:
      repository - source of the server metadata

    • UpdateService

      public UpdateService(UpdateRepository repository, EventBus eventBus)
      Creates a service publishing on an existing bus, typically the one shared by the host and its plugins.
      Parameters:
      repository - source of the server metadata
      eventBus - bus to publish on; null creates a private one

    • UpdateService

      public UpdateService(UpdateRepository repository, EventBus eventBus, Properties config)
      Parameters:
      repository - source of the server metadata
      eventBus - bus to publish on; null creates a private one, which shutdown() then closes
      config - settings to run with; null loads the packaged defaults overlaid by the user configuration file

  • Method Details

    • createDefault

      public static UpdateService createDefault(EventBus eventBus)
      Builds a service on a shared event bus using the layered configuration.

      Preferred entry point for hosts that already own the bus: it loads the configuration once, honours update.url when constructing the UpdateRepository, then hands both over to the service.

      Parameters:
      eventBus - bus to publish on; null creates a private one
      Returns:
      the wired service

    • createDefault

      Returns:
      the wired service

      public CompletableFuture<UpdateInfo> checkForUpdatesQuietly()

    • installNow

      public void installNow(UpdateInfo update) throws UpdateException
      Downloads, verifies and installs an update on the calling thread. The JVM is restarted by the platform specific installation script, so this method never returns on success.
      Parameters:
      update - the update to install
      Throws:
      UpdateException - when any stage of the pipeline fails

    • stageUpdate

      public CompletableFuture<Path> stageUpdate(UpdateInfo update)
      Downloads and verifies an update in the background without installing it, so a later installation (manual or deferred) reuses the staged file.
      Parameters:
      update - the update to stage
      Returns:
      a future holding the verified JAR path

    • evaluateRollbackOnStartup

      public RollbackTrigger.Outcome evaluateRollbackOnStartup(RollbackTrigger.HealthCheck health)
      Evaluates the start-up health right after an update and rolls the IDE back to the previous version when the new one is broken (roadmap §10.2). The host calls this once, early in the start-up sequence, before the update service starts proposing new updates.
      Parameters:
      health - reports whether the application started correctly
      Returns:
      the outcome of the evaluation

    • applyConfiguration

      public void applyConfiguration(Properties updates)
      Applies settings changed at runtime, without touching the disk.

      Desktop notifications are toggled immediately and the periodic checks are rescheduled when the channel or the interval changed. Call saveConfiguration(Properties) to make the change permanent.

      Parameters:
      updates - settings to merge into the running configuration
